svg.title: Secure Document Intelligence local system architecture
svg.desc: A numbered local control and data flow: the review UI calls the API; the API records state and jobs in durable DynamoDB Local; a separate worker claims state, reads and writes quarantine and adapters, then records clean promotion, audit, and review evidence.
svg.text: Credential-free Compose path · deterministic fixture mode · durable state and worker boundary
TRUST BOUNDARY: FILES AND EXTRACTED TEXT ARE UNTRUSTED DATA

g.text: 1 UI → API · 2 API → durable state/job · 3–4 worker ↔ state · 5 worker ↔ quarantine/adapters
* Ollama and ClamAV are optional Compose profiles; fixture mode keeps tests deterministic. AWS Architecture Icons visual language attributed to the official AWS resource.
